newsitem.title: EGYPT: High liquidity lowers Egypt pound interbank rates.
newsitem.headline: High liquidity lowers Egypt pound interbank rates.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Thursday in a very liquid private-sector market to around seven percent from Wednesday's range of seven and 8-1/2 percent, bankers said.

Two of the four most active banks in the market said they did not make one-week deals on the pound because of the upcoming Coptic Christian feast holiday which will extend the two-day weekend until Monday. The rest said rates also hovered around 7 percent, down from rates of eight and 8-3/4 percent.
"People who have money to invest are better off holding it than doing interbank deals. It's a super liquid market," one banker said.
Another banker attributed the liquidity in the market to the 1.33 billion pounds the Central Bank rejected in Wednesday's 91-day treasury bill auction.
Public sector banks maintained their 10-1/2 percent rate.
